newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BOMB EXPLODES IN CENTRAL SOFIA, NOBODY HURT.
newsitem.headline: BOMB EXPLODES IN CENTRAL SOFIA, NOBODY HURT.

text.p: A bomb exploded in one of Sofia's central squares early on Wednesday but nobody was injured, police said.
Police also said the explosion, which occured at the Russian Memorial Square, caused little damage. They declined to comment on a possible motive for the attack.
Bomb explosions have become commonplace in Bulgaria in recent years and are often linked to racketeering or the settling of accounts between rival criminal gangs.
